title: Vampire Vape Cool Red Lips Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Stimulate your senses with Vampire Vape’s Cool Red Lips, a tantalising concoction that blends succulent candied cherries with a surprising menthol gust. The refreshing breeze weaves its way through the mixture, accentuating the divine fruit flavours and delivering an unforgettable experience. This innovative twist on the classic gummy sweet offers a more profound flavour hit, transforming it into a strong contender for your all-day vape of choice. Surrender to the tempting allure of Cool Red Lips and immerse yourself in a delightful dance of fruity, sugary sweetness and invigorating freshness. Add to VG/PG DIY Mixing Products for optimum flavour. All Vampire Vape flavour concentrates are 100% PG based. Please note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
